decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'Save a bookmark by entering a url'/'POST ... full CRUD'. Client r1: 'I can save ... bookmarks. I accept the app.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Save-by-URL conforms to reference; client gives only bare approval, no divergence.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'Add / edit / delete via a modal'. Client r1: 'I can ... edit ... bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Edit capability present and conforming; bare approval only.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'Add / edit / delete via a modal' / 'DELETE /api/bookmarks/:id'. Client r1: 'I can ... delete bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Delete conforms; bare approval.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'favicons, clickable tag pills on cards' / card list UI. Client r1: 'I can ... organize ... bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. List exposes title/tags/favicon per item, conforms; bare approval.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'tag normalization/dedup' / 'clickable tag pills on cards'. Client r1: 'I can ... organize'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Assigning tags present and conforming; bare approval.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'clickable tag list with counts' / 'tag' filter on GET /api/bookmarks. Client r1: 'I can find, organize'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Filter-to-single-tag present and conforming; bare approval.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'Live debounced search across title, URL, description, tags'. Client r1: 'I can ... find ... bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Basic full-text search over title/description/url present (note field absent because no note feature); presented scope conforms. Advanced operators (REF-BM-13..16) were not presented, so not separable decisions.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'title defaults to URL' and lists 'auto-fetching page titles from URLs' among 'Possible next features'; favicons only via Google service. Client r1: 'I accept the app.' (no mention).
decisions.note: Prototype review. Auto-collection of title/description/preview is absent (only favicon-by-domain), diverging from REF-BM-02; maker surfaced it as future work, but client gave bare acceptance with no expression of the difference.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'Possible next features: ... bulk actions ...'. Client r1: 'This does what I need ... I accept the app.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Bulk actions / apply-to-filtered-collection absent, presented as future; client did not express or request. Bare approval does not establish awareness.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'Possible next features: ... sorting options ...'. Client r1: 'I accept the app.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Sort-by-key absent, flagged as future by maker; client gave no corrective or explicit disposition.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'Possible next features: import/export (browser HTML or JSON) ...'. Client r1: 'This does what I need ... I accept the app.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Netscape-HTML import/export absent, presented as future work; client accepted without expressing the difference.

decision.evidence: Maker r1: 'No auth (single shared bookmark list). Want per-user accounts/login?'. Client r1: 'A single shared list is fine; I don't need accounts.'
decision.note: Prototype review / offered choice. The no-auth single-user default matches the reference's single-user scope; multi-user is infra (excluded). The client's explicit statement affirms the conforming default, so this is not a divergence and not a capture (alternatives differ only on an excluded infra item).
